chapterInfo.content:
40
Hiob brɛ ne ho ase, AWURADE asɛm a ɛtɔ so mmienu. Susono ne ɔdɛnkyɛmmirampɔn
1Na AWURADE buaa Hiob sɛ:
2 # Yes 45.9 Ɔtɛnyifoɔ bi ne Otumfoɔ no bɛham anaa?
Deɛ ɔne Onyankopɔn gye akyinnyeɛ no, ɔmmua ɛ!
3Na Hiob gyee AWURADE so sɛ:
4Hwɛ, mesua, ɛdeɛn na memfa memmua woɔ?
Me nsa na mede meto m’ano.
5Makasa prɛko, na merentia so;
ne mprenu, na merenkɔ so bio.
6Ɛnna AWURADE firi ahum no mu buaa Hiob sɛ:
7 # Hiob 38.3 Bɔ w’asene sɛ ɔbarima ɛ,
mɛbisa wo, na woakyerɛ me.
8 # Hiob 37.5 Wobɛdane m’atemmuo no ani?
Wobɛbu me fɔ na woadi bem?
9Wowɔ nsa sɛ Nyankopɔn deɛ,
na wobɛtumi de nne a ɛte sɛ ne deɛ abom?
10Ɛnneɛ fa tumidie ne kɛseyɛ hyehyɛ wo ho,
na fira ɔhyerɛn ne animuonyam,
11hwie w’abufuo mmorosoɔ no gu,
na hwɛ ɔhantanni biara na brɛ no ase.
12Hwɛ ahantanfoɔ nyinaa na brɛ wɔn ase,
na tiatia abɔnefoɔ so wɔ wɔn tenabea hɔ.
13Fa wɔn nyinaa sie dɔteɛ mu,
na ma wɔn anim ntintim ahuntaeɛm,
14ɛnneɛ na me nso mɛkamfo wo
sɛ wo ara wo nifa na agye woɔ.
15Hwɛ susono a meyɛɛ no ne wo,
ewira na ɔdi no sɛ nantwie.
16Hwɛ ne tumi a ɛwɔ n’asene mu
ne n’ahoɔden a ɛwɔ ne yafunu ntini mu.
17Ɔkoa ne dua sɛ tweneduro,
ne srɛ mu nhoma nso toatoa mu.
18Ne nnompe te sɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ dorobɛn,
ne nkasɛɛ te sɛ adaban.
19Ɔno ne Nyankopɔn akwan mfitiaseɛ,
ne yɛfoɔ nko ara na ɔtumi de afena ka no.
20Na mmepɔ so aduane ma no,
na wiram mmoadoma nyinaa goro hɔnom.
21Nkasɛɛnkasɛɛ nnua ase na ɔda,
demmire ne ɔwora ahuntaeɛm.
22Nkasɛɛnkasɛɛ nnua nwunu kata ne so,
nsunoa nnua twa ne ho hyia.
23Hwɛ, asuo ano yɛ den mpo a, ne ho mpopo;
sɛ Yordan bu ba n’ano mpo a, ne bo da ne yam ara.
24Wɔbɛtumi akye no animono,
na wɔde fidie ahwire ne hwenem?

pageProps.chapterText:
Na AWURADE buaa Hiob sɛ:
Ɔtɛnyifoɔ bi ne Otumfoɔ no bɛham anaa?
Deɛ ɔne Onyankopɔn gye akyinnyeɛ no, ɔmmua ɛ!

Na Hiob gyee AWURADE so sɛ:
Hwɛ, mesua, ɛdeɛn na memfa memmua woɔ?
Me nsa na mede meto m’ano.
Makasa prɛko, na merentia so;
ne mprenu, na merenkɔ so bio.

Ɛnna AWURADE firi ahum no mu buaa Hiob sɛ:
Bɔ w’asene sɛ ɔbarima ɛ,
mɛbisa wo, na woakyerɛ me.
Wobɛdane m’atemmuo no ani?
Wobɛbu me fɔ na woadi bem?
Wowɔ nsa sɛ Nyankopɔn deɛ,
na wobɛtumi de nne a ɛte sɛ ne deɛ abom?

Ɛnneɛ fa tumidie ne kɛseyɛ hyehyɛ wo ho,
na fira ɔhyerɛn ne animuonyam,
hwie w’abufuo mmorosoɔ no gu,
na hwɛ ɔhantanni biara na brɛ no ase.
Hwɛ ahantanfoɔ nyinaa na brɛ wɔn ase,
na tiatia abɔnefoɔ so wɔ wɔn tenabea hɔ.
Fa wɔn nyinaa sie dɔteɛ mu,
na ma wɔn anim ntintim ahuntaeɛm,
ɛnneɛ na me nso mɛkamfo wo
sɛ wo ara wo nifa na agye woɔ.

Hwɛ susono a meyɛɛ no ne wo,
ewira na ɔdi no sɛ nantwie.
Hwɛ ne tumi a ɛwɔ n’asene mu
ne n’ahoɔden a ɛwɔ ne yafunu ntini mu.
Ɔkoa ne dua sɛ tweneduro,
ne srɛ mu nhoma nso toatoa mu.
Ne nnompe te sɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ dorobɛn,
ne nkasɛɛ te sɛ adaban.

Ɔno ne Nyankopɔn akwan mfitiaseɛ,
ne yɛfoɔ nko ara na ɔtumi de afena ka no.
Na mmepɔ so aduane ma no,
na wiram mmoadoma nyinaa goro hɔnom.
Nkasɛɛnkasɛɛ nnua ase na ɔda,
demmire ne ɔwora ahuntaeɛm.
Nkasɛɛnkasɛɛ nnua nwunu kata ne so,
nsunoa nnua twa ne ho hyia.
Hwɛ, asuo ano yɛ den mpo a, ne ho mpopo;
sɛ Yordan bu ba n’ano mpo a, ne bo da ne yam ara.
Wɔbɛtumi akye no animono,
na wɔde fidie ahwire ne hwenem?

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
